scope: TNV-009A only: entry authentication, request boundaries, SSE ownership/key exclusion, ping context. Local loopback, synthetic key held in memory, no child tunnel instances. Ordinary Instance field concurrency, import/process quotas and complete shutdown remain open.
native_adapter: Old adapter copies the route registration/middleware block verbatim from Run at before_source_commit. Fixed adapter calls actual shared Handler. Each native report records adapter SHA, template SHA and runner SHA. No production source instrumentation.
